declaredBreaks.reason: The deprecated MCP tools set_project, get_current_project, set_agent, clear_agent and get_current_agent are removed. MCP clients discover tools from tools/list, so agents pick up the change on their next session; only scripted callers that hard-code one of these names get an unknown-tool error. get_context reports the stored project and agent, route_agent selects an agent, and every project-scoped tool takes projectUuid (and optionally agentUuid) explicitly. Stored context written by older clients or route_agent is still honoured.
